Author: pmyan
Name: QoLBarEx
Description: I have made some optimizations that I believe are worthwhile. Please take a look at the original repository.
Punchline:
A plugin designed to provide a simple, customizable and always available interface for chat commands
or other plugins to alleviate the need for using macros and hotbar space to achieve similar results.

The plugin should initially appear as a small box on the bottom center of the game window.

Author: pmyan
Name: MappyEx
Description: 在原版 Mappy 基础上完成完整的中英双语适配，并加入永久地图标记、标记分组、vnavmesh 前往/飞向、地图右键导航等功能。分组可自建并统一图标与大小，工具栏单按钮切换显隐。不能与上游 Mappy 同时启用。非原创，请瞻仰原仓库实现
Punchline: A more versatile in-game map, with full Simplified Chinese support.

Author: pmyan
Name: Chat2Ex
Description: 在原版 ChatTwo 基础上改为使用原生同层级的UI。不能与上游 ChatTwo 同时启用。非原创，请瞻仰原仓库实现
Punchline:
Chat2Ex is a complete rewrite of the in-game chat window as a plugin.
It supports:

- Unlimited tabs
- Tabs that always send to a certain channel
- More flexible filtering
- RGB channel colouring
- Completely variable font size
- Sidebar tabs
- Unread counts
- Emotes
- Screenshot mode (obfuscate names)
